tiktok.creative_rules: 9:16 vertical ONLY. Lo-fi UGC authentic feel — handheld POV selfie camera. High contrast warm tones. Product visible within first 2 seconds. Bold Impact font text overlays with slight rotation. Leave top 15% and bottom 20% clear for TikTok UI. Ad must feel NATIVE — not corporate. Think 'I stopped scrolling for this'.

meta.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait preferred for maximum mobile news feed visibility. Bright clear high-quality lighting. Product-focused hero layout. Brand-aligned color palette. Bold benefit headline in sans-serif typography. Shop Now CTA button visible. Clean background with product as central hero element.

youtube.creative_rules: 16:9 landscape for in-stream ads. Balanced professional lighting. Demo-focused walkthrough format. Product clearly visible with strong contrast. Bold condensed headline text (3-6 words max). Clean composition with one strong focal point.

pinterest.creative_rules: 2:3 vertical tall pin format. Aspirational lifestyle aesthetic. Clean benefit text overlay in serif or elegant sans-serif. Product beautifully styled with soft muted or bold high-contrast tones. Pin must feel 'save-worthy' — users are planning and dreaming.

instagram.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait for feed ads. Bold sans-serif typography (Inter/Montserrat style). Vibrant or pastel gradient backgrounds. Product as hero element. Mix of polished and authentic UGC styles. CTA button or text clearly visible. Feed-cohesive design.

facebook.creative_rules: 4:5 portrait for mobile news feed. Clear well-lit product presentation. Trust-building headline text. Problem-solution ad format. Shop Now CTA. Warm approachable tone. Broader demographic — avoid overly Gen-Z aesthetics. Product clearly visible and identifiable.

x.creative_rules: 16:9 landscape for maximum tweet preview. High-contrast bold design. Sharp statement headline. Proof or comparison format. Dark mode friendly. Product clearly presented with bold claim. Retweet-worthy.
